Don't ever book this place via OYO, because once you will get there they will say that we don't accept OYO bookings because we don't have tie up with them anymore and then they will ask you to cancel the booking. They will verify if you have cancelled the booking or not on their end because they are still have tie up with OYO but want more money from you. They will then ask you to book again for more money. They are just cheating OYO and customers, both. Don't ever book this hotel. Not safe for couples as well. Rooms were dirty and bathroom was pathetic. I was suspicious if they have installed cameras in the rooms.

East Inn is an okay kinda of a hotel. The staff is friendly, cleanliness is okay.

The location of this hotel is perfect in East patel nagar market. Finding parking around can be tough however accessibility to the market makes it a perfect spot.

There are good restaurants, atms and all kinds of stores nearby.

Metro station is around half a km away.
